prompt: Was the person who served as president of the Scottish National Party from 1987 to 2005 alive when the party was founded?
answer: Yes. Winnie Ewing was born on July 10, 1929, and the Scottish National Party was founded on April 7, 1934, so she was alive and nearly five years old when the party was founded.
